goals.0: The Krypton intro page shows a Base64 string — decode it to get the first password.
goals.1: The password file for the next level sits in /krypton/krypton1, rotated by ROT13.
goals.2: A Caesar cipher — one fixed shift for every letter — hides the password in /krypton/krypton2.
goals.3: A monoalphabetic substitution cipher in /krypton/krypton3 — letter-frequency analysis on the sample texts breaks it.
goals.4: Vigenere with a known key length of 6 — frequency analysis per key position recovers the key.
goals.5: Vigenere again, but the key length is unknown — work it out first, then repeat the frequency attack.
goals.6: encrypt6 is an LFSR stream cipher — known plaintext exposes the keystream, and LFSRs are not random.
goals.7: Final account: logging in as krypton7 completes the Krypton series.
